acceptance_criteria.criterion: The project list table has a Repository column showing the repo folder name (or — if unavailable)
The repository column value is included in text-filter searches
The project detail h1 shows meta.title when set, otherwise the slug
Clicking the edit icon on the detail page switches the heading to an input
Pressing Enter or blurring the input calls PATCH /api/projects/:slug and updates the heading on success
An error from the API is surfaced to the user (inline message or notification)
The breadcrumb (if present) reflects the updated title after rename
CSS prevents the inline input from looking out-of-place relative to the h1
No console errors on page load or interaction

summary: Added renameProject(slug, title) to the API client (PATCH method).
Added Repository column to buildTable(): data-repo attribute on <tr>, <th>Repository</th> header, <td class='repo-col'> cell with escapeHtml(p.repository_name || '—').
Updated applyFilter() to include data-repo attribute in text-filter searches.
Rewrote the project detail breadcrumb and h1 to display meta.title when set, otherwise the slug.
Wrapped h1 in .page-heading-wrapper with an adjacent .edit-title-btn (✎) pencil button.

Implemented inline edit mode: click pencil → <input class='title-edit-input'> replaces h1; Enter or blur calls API.renameProject and updates heading + breadcrumb; Escape cancels; errors shown in .title-edit-error div; Enter/blur race handled via inputDone flag.
Added CSS: .page-heading-wrapper, .edit-title-btn, .title-edit-input, .title-edit-error, .repo-col to styles.css.

comments.note: The enterEditMode guard (inputDone flag) cleanly prevents the blur+Enter double-save race without any setTimeout hack — clean idiomatic pattern.

summary: AC1 — Repository column: buildTable() sets data-repo on <tr> and renders <td class='repo-col'> with escapeHtml(p.repository_name || '—'). Header <th>Repository</th> present. ✅
AC2 — Filter: applyFilter() reads data-repo attribute into rowRepo and includes it in the indexOf search alongside rowSlug and rowName. ✅
AC3 — Title vs slug: displayTitle = (meta.title && meta.title.trim()) ? meta.title : slug. Both h1 and breadcrumb use this value. ✅
AC4 — Click-to-edit: editBtn click handler creates <input>, hides h1 and editBtn, inserts input, focuses and selects it. ✅
AC5 — Enter/blur → PATCH + update: doSave() calls API.renameProject (PATCH /api/projects/:slug), then updates headingEl.textContent and breadcrumbEl.textContent on success. ✅
AC6 — Escape cancels: keydown listener on Escape sets inputDone=true and calls exitEdit() without touching the API. ✅
AC7 — Error surfaced: catch block creates/reuses #title-edit-error div with .title-edit-error class and writes 'Rename failed: ...' message. Resets inputDone to allow retry. ✅
AC8 — Breadcrumb update: breadcrumbEl.textContent = newTitle executed in the .then() callback after successful rename. ✅
AC9 — CSS cohesion: .title-edit-input matches h1 with font-size:1.5rem + font-weight:700; .page-heading-wrapper uses inline-flex; all related classes present in styles.css. ✅
AC10 — No console errors: null guards on editBtn/headingEl, optional breadcrumbEl access, silent health-badge failure — no uncaught paths identified. ✅
Full backend chain confirmed: PATCH route in server.ts → handleRenameProject in api.ts → store.updateTitle in ledger-store.ts. TypeScript noEmit: 0 errors.

comments.note: No observations — code is clean and consistent. inputDone flag elegantly prevents blur+Enter double-save without setTimeout hacks. All null guards are in place. escapeHtml() applied consistently to all user-visible data.

summary: Reviewed mcp-server/gui/public/app.js and mcp-server/gui/public/styles.css. All 10 acceptance criteria verified through direct source inspection.
renameProject() in the API client correctly uses PATCH with encodeURIComponent on the slug — consistent with all other API methods.

buildTable(): data-repo attribute and <td class='repo-col'> both use escapeHtml(), eliminating any XSS surface. The em-dash fallback uses the Unicode escape \u2014 rather than a literal character — good practice for a JS string.
applyFilter(): rowRepo is pulled from data-repo, lowercased, and included in the indexOf chain alongside rowSlug and rowName — correct and minimal.

Inline title edit implementation is clean: inputDone flag correctly prevents the blur+Enter double-save race without any setTimeout; it is reset to false on error to permit retry. The exitEdit() cleanup removes both the input and any stale error div, leaving DOM pristine.
currentTitle is updated to newTitle on success before exitEdit(), so re-triggering the edit input opens with the latest saved value, not the stale display.
Error element uses getElementById before createElement to prevent duplicate nodes on rapid retries. Inserted after the input via insertBefore(errEl, input.nextSibling) — correct placement.

CSS: .title-edit-input uses font-size:1.5rem + font-weight:700 matching the h1 exactly, zero layout shift on toggle. max-width:600px + width:40ch gives a sensible default while constraining overflow. .page-heading-wrapper as inline-flex avoids taking up the full row width. All classes exercised by the feature are present.

comments.note: inputDone flag is a textbook solution to the blur+Enter race — avoids setTimeout hacks and handles error-state retry cleanly by resetting to false in the catch block.
Using \u2014 (Unicode escape) for the em-dash fallback in the JS string rather than a literal character is robust against encoding issues in source files.
